about: Outreach Recruitment is recruiting on behalf of our client in the automotive industry for a proactive, detail-oriented Warranty Administrator to join its aftersales team in Gżira.

The Warranty Administrator carries out a wide range of administrative and office support duties linked to vehicle warranties: processing warranty paperwork, entering claims in manufacturer systems so every hour and material cost is recovered, handling rejected claims, and keeping the workshop informed on recalls and warranty cases.

You will work closely with the aftersales, parts and accounts teams and support manufacturer audits. The role is full-time and on-site, with a competitive salary, health insurance, a loyalty card and specialised training locally or abroad.
responsibilities: Process warranty paperwork and keep documentation up to date as the manufacturer requires
Enter correct warranty data in manufacturer systems so every hour and material cost is claimed and recovered
Make sure warranty exchanged parts are stored in line with manufacturer policy
Review warranty claims, correct errors and liaise with the manufacturer when in doubt
Advise the workshop on recall and warranty cases as stipulated by the manufacturer
Ensure correct rendition of warranty claims with the franchise and report on defective parts
Keep good working relationships with the aftersales and parts departments
Prioritise customer satisfaction on recall campaigns and make sure they are completed on time
Attend manufacturer audits and provide documentation to auditors
Keep up to date with warranty updates, factory recalls and manufacturer announcements
Reconcile warranty receivables and work with accounts to obtain payment
Liaise with the Assistant Manager on the technical implementation of recall campaigns
Handle rejected claims to dealership and manufacturer specifications and follow up outstanding claims
Liaise with the body and paint shop where it is involved in warranty work and recall campaigns
Maintain service and customer records as required by the warrantor
Attend required training, locally and abroad, and carry out additional duties assigned by the Aftersales Manager
Follow health and safety regulations, company policies and franchise standards
requirements: ECDL and a good working knowledge of web-based applications
Previous experience in warranty claims will be considered an asset
Active listening, reading comprehension and clear speaking skills
A proactive, detail-oriented approach to administration
